# Media requests sub-actions

## Add media request

Adds a YouTube video to the request queue from an action, as if a viewer asked. Good for your own "play this" button or command.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **YouTube link or video id** | A YouTube link or the 11-letter video id. The default %rawInput% is what a viewer typed after the command. Starts as: `%rawInput%`. |
| **Requested by** | Who asked for it, shown with the video. The default %user% is whoever started the action. Starts as: `%user%`. |
| **Platform** | The site that person is on, like twitch. The default %platform% is whoever started the action. Starts as: `%platform%`. |
| **Free (no points, no per-viewer limit)** | Tick so it costs no points and skips the request rules (requests closed, per-viewer limit). Unticked, the normal rules apply. Leave it ticked for your own actions. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%success%` | True if it was added |
| `%error%` | If it was not added: the reason, like "that is not a YouTube link" |
| `%title%` | The video's title |
| `%requestId%` | The request's internal id |

<small>Type id: `media.request`</small>

## Control media requests

Controls the song and video request queue: skip the current one, pause, resume, clear the queue, open or close requests, or set the volume.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Do** | Skip = next video. Pause/Resume = stop or continue. Clear the queue = remove all waiting requests and give points back. Open/Close requests = allow or block new ones. Set volume = change loudness. Options: Skip, Pause, Resume, Clear the queue (refunds), Open requests, Close requests, Set volume. Starts as: `Skip`. |
| **Volume (0 to 100)** | Only for Set volume: how loud, from 0 (silent) to 100 (full). Starts as: `50`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%success%` | True if it worked (for example, false if there was nothing to skip) |
| `%removed%` | Only for Clear the queue: how many requests were removed |

<small>Type id: `media.control`</small>
